high_level_description: An original action-adventure game heroine stands inside an ancient stone ruin, ready for exploration, presented as a polished character concept illustration for a cinematic adventure game.

style_description.aesthetics: cinematic adventure mood, confident heroic tone, premium action game presentation, grounded realism
style_description.lighting: soft directional sunlight entering through a ruined opening, subtle ambient bounce from stone walls, controlled contrast on the character silhouette
style_description.art_style: AAA action-adventure concept art with realistic anatomy, practical explorer outfit design, refined material rendering, believable utility gear, and strong but natural facial features

compositional_deconstruction.background: An ancient ruin interior with carved stone walls, broken pillars, scattered dust, hanging vines, and a distant opening suggesting a forgotten tomb environment.

elements.desc: A single original female explorer character placed as the central subject, with an athletic build, a confident relaxed pose, alert expression, tied-back hair, fitted expedition clothing, fingerless gloves, durable boots, a utility belt, a climbing rope, and a small satchel.
Explorer gear details visible on the character, including a flashlight, map pouch, holsters, weathered fabric textures, and practical accessories designed for gameplay readability.
